display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-09 Innovative technologies and solutions to improve wave and tidal energy systems – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-09 Innovative technologies and solutions to improve wave and tidal energy systems
executive_summary: Develops and demonstrates wave and tidal technologies, including electrical connections, under a directly funded consortium grant that also requires onward grants. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 43 million, with around EUR 43 million expected per project. Opening 2026-12-03, full proposal deadline 2027-03-31 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 133–140, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to Hollandse Kust. Annex B permits funded Dutch consortium membership and the scope includes electrical power-transmission connections. TenneT could do connection engineering within the funded core consortium. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states an estimated duration of around 5 years but no start or end date.
